title: Page 169
transc:
Gen Butlers Hd May 28 / 64 
Maj Eckert Di  11.30 Pm
reliance harsh paddle for Judah Zodiac Am now quarrelling
I will proceed as rapidly as possible now Homer
or white house according as I find it best
to land to secure the welch patent at White
house I have pebble pagans all I deem necessary
& all certainly that I have whig for zodiac 
I will wrangle my progress from time to time
but I shall send a pardon on fast steamers
& a pagoda of negro to secure the patent
in advance of my arrival with the main body
Walrus Nankin We must get along without cable here 
R OBrien 


Ft. Monroe May 29 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
Knox favors pocketing at Hastings and the torrent route
pedlar Mack and party with Homan and Collings arrived
at Jamestown last night Pekin Had to land them
there as they came down on regular dispatch boat .
Pekin would have been better if they had come
here unity They will arrive at Haven this afternoon
by land zodiac will hurry the work pedlar will
lay the Cables and have all ready zodiac propeller
Detroit with material arrived yesterday was sent to Hastings
and the material is landed on Gloucester side zebra
Operators will be distributed according to orders windy morning
Geo D Sheldon
